subject: Org ignition: admin seats, service keys, and invite sweep
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@zenwell.health>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Oct 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Org ignition: admin seats, service keys, and invite sweep

Hi Samir / Monica,

Quick note to align on the initial tenant lift-off for ZenWell. Goal: have admin roster, a seeded service key for the ingestion pipeline, and initial user invite sweep completed by EOD next Thursday (10/23). Proposed play: 

- Step 1: Confirm admin roster (who needs Owner vs Admin vs Billing roles). I attached a simple matrix to capture names and roles.
- Step 2: Seed a service key scoped to the ingestion project (short-lived key now, rotate after test). Dev, can you prepare a key template and TTL?
- Step 3: Invite wave: Seed 5 admin seats, then 10 editor seats next week. We'll use the invite link and enforce SSO option.

Samir: can you confirm the list of initial admins and whether procurement wants the contract reference included in the invite? If procurement needs accounting metadata, we'll add the PO number field to the invite template.

Attachments: zenwell_admin_matrix_v1.xlsx (admin-role matrix), redwood-invite-quickstart.pdf (invite flow + SSO notes)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@zenwell.health>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zenwell.health, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 09:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Org ignition: admin seats, service keys, and invite sweep

Alex / Monica,

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Admin roster: I'll be primary Owner (Samir Shah). Secondary admins: Priya N. (IT Ops), Jorge L. (Security). I'll drop full names and emails into the attached matrix by EOD today.
- Procurement: please include contract ref ZW-2025-114 in the invite footer; procurement@zenwell.health is copied for the PO flow.
- SSO: we will enable SSO for all admins; our IdP team will need the SAML metadata. I'll ask them to expect the SAML URL.

Two asks:
1) Can the seeded service key be restricted to the ingestion project and set to expire after 14 days?
2) We need a short written checklist for our security team showing key rotation and audit logging steps.

Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Product, ZenWell Health

Folks — forwarding Samir's reply and procurement copy. Action items for implementation sprint:

1) Dev: create a service key template with the following: scope=projects/zenwell-ingest, ttl=14d, disabled by default, rotation doc link included in key metadata. Respond with the CLI command + sample JSON. Attach to the thread when ready. (ETA: 10/21 EOD)

2) Monica: update the invite email template to include contract ref ZW-2025-114 in the footer and a short note about SSO availability. Also add a field in the invite flow for PO number (optional). I'll push the updated matrix into Drive.

3) Security checklist: draft a 1-page summary of rotation + audit log locations for Samir's security team (Monica / Dev can help). We can reuse Redwood's standard key rotation template but make it specific to the ingestion key.

Attachments referenced again: zenwell_admin_matrix_v1.xlsx, redwood-invite-quickstart.pdf

Thanks,
Alex

I'll follow up after the seeded key is posted so we can coordinate the invite wave.
